text_block_list.name: Young Girl
text_block_list.text:
*sniff*, waaaah...
I dropped my snack~!

text_block_list.name: Young Palmer
text_block_list.text:
...Alright, I'll give you mine!
I'm already totally full anyway!
Go ahead and enjoy it for me!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
—This is fine.
It's not like I'm putting on a brave face or anything.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: After all, that's my role, right?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I-I-I-I'm so,
sooooo sorrrryyyyyy!!!!

A loud apology suddenly echoed through the air.
Wondering what had happened, I turned around to see items scattered all over from a dropped cardboard box.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
No need to apologize!
More importantly, are you okay? Not hurt, are you?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm fine... physically...!
Ahhh, but I have to clean this up right away!

text_block_list.name: Broadcast
text_block_list.text: "Meisho Doto-san, Opera O-san has grown restless while waiting for your joint run and has begun performing an opera. Please report to the track immediately."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Eeeeeeek?!
Th-That's right! I have to clean this up in a hurry!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Hold up, hold up.
I'll handle things here, so you go on ahead!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Huh? B-But I scattered things so terribly—

text_block_list.name: Horse Girls
text_block_list.text:
—Ow?! Something fell from above!
—Why are there so many notebooks scattered around here?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... Well, no worries!
I'll clean it all up together!
Opera O's waiting for you, right?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Auugh, I'm so sorryyyy!!
As soon as I finish running, I'll come right back~~!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Alrighty then... man, this is one heck of a mess.
Well, time to get to it!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Wait, really? That's a huge help, honestly!
Sorry for dragging you in, let's knock this out quick!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Whoa?! Other boxes got knocked over too!
To think this much damage happened in a single second...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Supplies even flew all the way over here...
Honestly, that's practically a miracle in itself.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Wait, huh? You got startled by something falling from above and tumbled into the fountain?
...W-Well, let's get your clothes dried off first!
Together with Mejiro Palmer, we gradually took care of the aftermath—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I'm so sorry... In the end, I couldn't help clean up anything myself...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ah, don't worry about it at all!
More importantly, how was your run?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you, I had a great run~.
Um... really, thank you so much.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Huh? If it isn't Palmer-chin.
Why're you still hanging around here~?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Didn't you say you were gonna buy that limited edition stuff today?!
You gonna make it in time?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, it's totally fine.
Even if it's limited, they've done reruns before anyway.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Besides, Doto's situation was way more important, right? Yep!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Eeeeeeek~~?!
Um, I'm so sorry, I'm so sorry!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Like I said, you really don't need to worry about it.
If you were able to run well, Doto, that makes me even happier.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Anyway, since we've got some awkward free time now, how about we all hit karaoke?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Huhhh?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Are you free too, Helios?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Totally okemarru~! Palmer, Doto, I'm gonna hype y'all all the way up!!
Trainer over there, you come on along too!!
choice_data_list: I've got plans, so maybe next time.
I've got plans, so maybe next time.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Totally okemarru~! Palmer, Doto, I'm gonna hype y'all all the way up!!
Trainer over there, you come on along too!!
choice_data_list: I've got plans, so maybe next time.
I've got plans, so maybe next time.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Of course! If you're coming, you're more than welcome!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: You helped out with so much, let me treat you as thanks. Alright?

Mejiro Palmer was always so attentive and considerate.
Yet, I couldn't help but wonder if she was truly okay with prioritizing others over herself...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: For real, a pass...? Aw man...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Trainer has plans, so it can't be helped.
Come on, let's get going!!

Mejiro Palmer was truly considerate of others.
Recognizing that as one of her greatest qualities, I saw the three of them off as they headed toward karaoke.
